title: The Warden's Patrol
description: The borderlands outpost stands half-manned — three of the sentry's watch are down with the fever and the King's Road runs unwatched. Walk the line for him: the outpost, the fouled well the water carries the sickness through, and back to Scout Mira who keeps the village end of the road. A patrol is only as good as the report it brings home.

objectives.desc: Check the fouled well on the road
Close the patrol with Scout Mira
